title: A download with a presigned URL
claim: The file travels directly from Amazon S3 to the user, not through the app server.
alt: A sequence with three actors: a user, an app server and Amazon S3. The user asks the app server for a file. The app server signs a URL and returns it. The user sends a GET request with the presigned URL to Amazon S3, and Amazon S3 returns the object to the user.

messages.label: Ask for file
messages.say: The user asks the app server for a file.

messages.label: Sign URL
messages.say: The app server signs a URL for the object with its own credentials.

messages.label: Presigned URL
messages.say: The app server returns the presigned URL to the user.

messages.label: GET with URL
messages.say: The user sends a GET request with the presigned URL directly to Amazon S3.

messages.label: Object
messages.say: Amazon S3 checks the signature and returns the object.
